usedFor: Signaturit tracks documents and emails for signing, and Instagram for Business receives a story from them through “Publish Instagram Story”.

bestTemplate.name: “Document Signed” in Signaturit, then “Publish Instagram Story” in Instagram for Business
bestTemplate.why: A signed document is worth sharing, and the action posts a photo or video from a public URL.

watchOut: “Publish Instagram Story” needs media at a public URL, and “Document Signed” gives a document event, so supply the media.
